notes: New Fonts section for admins: upload .woff2/.woff/.ttf/.otf files, preview them, and delete them.
Assign uploaded families to main text, display/headings, Arabic, Enochian, and CJK, in priority order.
Assignments apply to the whole site for every user; built-in fonts and the I Ching/Enochian symbol catalog remain as fallbacks.
Font files and metadata are stored under storage/plugin-data/font-manager and survive plugin updates.
